title: 第6章 万宝堂第7章 突破第8章 惊变
slug: 开局战五渣我靠空间挂机修仙
content_zh:
万宝堂坐落于内城最繁华的街道上，楼高五层，在这个大部分建筑都是三层以下的坊市中，显得极为恢弘。
走进万宝堂，一楼分为丹、符、器几个区域，秦怀安走向法器专区。
“这位客人需要些什么呢？”一个伙计打扮的年轻修士迎上来道。
“我想出售一些矿石。”
“这边请。”伙计把秦怀安引入一个和宝华楼类似的小隔间，里面坐着一位中年修士。
“这是我们的鉴定师彭大师，客人可把需要出售的物品拿给彭大师估价。”
秦怀安事先已将赤铜矿石装进了储物袋中，取出储物袋递给鉴定师。
储物袋并未设禁制，鉴定师灵力输入储物袋，取出一些矿石看了看，“赤铜矿石，1斤0.6块灵石。”
“我们万宝堂鉴定师给的价格肯定公道，我帮你算一下总价？”伙计问道。
“可以，帮我算一下吧。”
“好嘞。”
伙计在旁边称过之后说道：“赤铜矿石斤，共计块下品灵石。”
“客人，这是116块中品灵石，73块下品灵石，您收好。”
“谢谢！麻烦带我看一下防御类的法器。”秦怀安决定先做好自身安全防护。
“这边请。”伙计带着秦怀安来到法器区。
“这个是一次性防御玉佩，受到攻击时，可瞬间撑起防护罩，可抵挡炼气四层全力一击，售价400灵石。”
“这个是下品法器玄铁盾，由玄铁制成，刻录有防御阵法，可抵挡炼气六层全力一击，售价1600下品灵石。”
“这个是天蚕玉衣，中品法器，采用百万大山中的二妖兽墨玉天蚕的丝线制成，并刻录有防御阵法，可抵挡炼气九层的一击。售价5000下品灵石。”
防御法器的价格太贵了，比同档次的攻击法器要贵很多。
又看了几样法器，秦怀安最终选择购买了那枚防御玉佩和天蚕玉衣。天蚕玉衣很轻薄，可以穿到内侧。防御法器虽贵，但原主被一拳毙命的场景还历历在目，不得不防。

之后他又分别购买了五张神行符，五张金刚符，三张盾甲符，都是一阶中品灵符，每张价格都在50灵石左右，共计花费650块下品灵石。
最后又选择了一个攻击类的中品法器，七星透骨针，一次可发射七枚玄铁精打造的小针。这个法器胜在小巧隐蔽，如果敌人在毫无防备之下，甚至可能越阶杀敌。配套购买了玄铁针五百枚，共计2000灵石。
出了万宝堂，秦怀安一共还剩余36块中品灵石和7300块左右的下品灵石。秦怀安没有在内城继续停留，直接回到了他租住的洞府。
回到洞府时已是下午，看着低矮的小房子和门口逼仄的小巷，秦怀安暗叹：“等再赚点灵石，一定要搬到更好的地方。”
回来后秦怀安并未停歇，盘坐在蒲团上，此时火球术已推演完毕；打开面板。
修为：炼气（二层
41100）
功法：青华诀（精通
1100，可推演）
火球术（精通
1100，可推演）
秦怀安感受了一下精通级火球术，凝聚火球时灵力流转明显更加顺畅，火球也更加精炼、威力也更加强大。
精通级火球术最多可凝聚一颗容纳体内10%灵力的火球，凝聚最大威力的火球大概需要15秒；若是凝聚5%灵力，仅需5秒。
“继续推演火球术”
【消耗80块灵石，镜像体可将火球术推演至小成，耗时4个时辰；消耗160灵石，耗时可减半】
content_en:
Wanbaotang is located on the most prosperous street in the inner city, with a five-story building. In this city where most buildings are three stories or less, it looks extremely grand.
Walking into Wanbao Hall, the first floor is divided into areas for elixirs, talismans, and utensils. Qin Huaian walked towards the area dedicated to magical utensils.
"What does this guest need?" A young monk dressed as a waiter came forward and asked.
"I want to sell some ore."
"Please come this way." The waiter led Qin Huaian into a small cubicle similar to the one in Baohua Building, where sat a middle-aged monk.
"This is our appraiser, Master Peng. Guests can bring the items they want to sell to Master Peng for appraisal."
Qin Huaian had already put the copper ore into a storage bag beforehand, took out the storage bag and handed it to the appraiser.
There is no restriction on the storage bag. The appraiser input his spiritual power into the storage bag, took out some ores and looked at them, "Red copper ore, 0.6 spiritual stones per kilogram."
"The price given by our Wanbaotang appraiser must be fair. Can I help you calculate the total price?" the clerk asked.
"Okay, do the math for me."
"Okay."
The clerk weighed it next to him and said: "One kilogram of red copper ore, totaling a piece of low-grade spiritual stone."
"Guest, here are 116 pieces of medium-grade spiritual stones and 73 pieces of low-grade spiritual stones. Please keep them."
"Thank you! Please show me some defensive magic weapons." Qin Huaian decided to protect his own safety first.
"Please come this way." The clerk led Qin Huaian to the magic weapon area.
"This is a one-time defensive jade pendant. When attacked, it can instantly hold up a protective shield. It can withstand a full blow from the fourth level of Qi Refining. It sells for 400 spirit stones."
"This is a low-grade magic weapon, the Black Iron Shield. It is made of dark iron and has a defensive formation inscribed on it. It can withstand a full blow from the sixth level of Qi Refining. It sells for 1,600 low-grade spiritual stones."
"This is the Celestial Silkworm Jade Clothes, a middle-grade magic weapon. It is made from the silk threads of the Black Jade Celestial Silkworm, the two demon beasts from the Million Mountains. It is inscribed with a defensive formation that can withstand a blow from the ninth level of Qi Refining. It sells for 5,000 low-grade spiritual stones."
The defensive magic weapon is too expensive, much more expensive than the offensive magic weapon of the same level.
After looking at a few more magic weapons, Qin Huaian finally chose to buy the defensive jade pendant and the Celestial Silkworm Jade Clothes. The silkworm jade garment is very light and can be worn to the inside. Although defensive magic weapons are expensive, the scene of the original owner being killed with one punch is still vivid in my mind and I have to guard against it.
After that, he purchased five divine walking talismans, five diamond talismans, and three shield talismans, all of which were first-level middle-grade spiritual talismans. Each one cost around 50 spiritual stones, totaling 650 low-grade spiritual stones.
Finally, he chose a medium-grade offensive magic weapon, the Seven-Star Penetrating Bone Needle, which can fire seven small needles made of black iron at one time. This magical weapon is small and concealed. If the enemy is unprepared, it may even kill the enemy by leaping through the ranks. Five hundred black iron needles were purchased as a package, totaling 2,000 spirit stones.
After leaving Wanbao Hall, Qin Huaian still had a total of 36 middle-grade spiritual stones and about 7,300 low-grade spiritual stones left. Qin Huaian did not stay in the inner city and returned directly to the cave he rented.
It was already afternoon when he returned to the cave. Looking at the small low-rise house and the narrow alley at the entrance, Qin Huaian sighed to himself: "When I earn more spiritual stones, I must move to a better place."
Qin Huaian didn't stop after he came back. He sat cross-legged on the futon. At this time, the fireball technique had been deduced; he opened the panel.
Cultivation: Qi Refining (Second Level
41100)
Kung Fu: Qing Hua Jue (Mastery
1100, can be deduced)
Fireball (Mastery
1100, can be deduced)
Qin Huaian experienced the master-level fireball technique. When condensing the fireball, the spiritual power flow was obviously smoother, and the fireball was more refined and more powerful.
Mastery-level fireball technique can condense a fireball that can hold up to 10% of the spiritual power in the body. It takes about 15 seconds to condense the most powerful fireball; if it condenses 5% of the spiritual power, it only takes 5 seconds.
"Continue to deduce the fireball technique"
[Consumption of 80 spirit stones, the mirror body can push the fireball spellIt takes 4 hours to complete the performance; it consumes 160 spirit stones, and the time can be halved]
